panels.description: Alex draws a worn photograph from his jacket; Grandmother smiles while Adrian’s face is folded and creased. Ada notices Alex’s clenched hand. Leave upper-left clear.
Alex studies the photograph while Ada’s hand stops before touching his shoulder. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
Sunset over the basin, Oasis brightening as Keel dims. Ada faces Alex. Leave upper sky open.
Ada’s steady face with Alex’s tightening fist in foreground. Leave upper-left clear.
Alex and Ada stand small against the darkening basin, separated by open space but still together. Leave lower corners clear.
Alex walks ahead while Ada looks back toward Oasis. Leave top-left clear.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Some days she knows me. Other days she calls me Adrian...

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: The hardest part isn't that she forgets. It's that she makes up crazy stories about him.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: That he wasn't gambling. That he was working.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: What do you actually remember about him?

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: So everything else is what people told you. What if they were wrong?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Maybe…Or maybe they're right. Either way... he's gone.
